name: Master Vornal
summary: In Sen'jin Village, Master Vornal brews for the Darkspear and guards the craft he has mastered. Though age has touched him, the elderly jungle troll refuses to teach an apprentice.

sections.title: The Stubborn Brewer of Sen'jin
sections.body: Master Vornal makes draughts and spirits for his fellow Darkspear trolls in Sen'jin Village. Age is catching up with him, yet he will not give up his independence. He refuses to train an apprentice and mixes every remedy and volatile brew himself.

sections.title: A Solvent Spirit
sections.body: At times, Master Vornal sends young adventurers into the surrounding lands for harsh or unusual ingredients. He uses them in solvents and other mixtures, and rewards those who bring them back. Yet he keeps his methods and recipes to himself, doing all the brewing by his own hand.

faq.answer: Master Vornal is an elderly Darkspear jungle troll who brews spirits and remedies in Sen'jin Village. He insists on working without an apprentice.

faq.q: Where can I find Master Vornal?
faq.answer: Master Vornal can be found among the huts of Sen'jin Village, on Durotar's southern coast just north of the Echo Isles.

faq.q: Why does Master Vornal refuse to take apprentices?
faq.answer: Master Vornal says no troll or orc worthy of his teaching has come forward. His eyesight is failing, and he leans more on alchemy, yet he would rather work alone than teach someone unworthy.

faq.q: What tasks does he offer adventurers?
faq.answer: Master Vornal sends wanderers across the region to gather raw ingredients for his solvent mixtures. He depends on travelers to bring the materials, then keeps the brewing to himself.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can see Master Vornal among the stubborn elder craftspeople who helped establish Sen'jin Village after the tribe fled its island home.
With Herbalism, you can recognize Master Vornal's search for rare catalysts and harsh natural reagents to make his solvents.
